quarterly_data.quarter: 10x Genomics press release: 10x Genomics Announces Sentira, a New Computational (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 10x Genomics announced Sentira, a new cloud analysis platform, beginning with Sentira Spatial Analysis. Sentira Spatial is available at no cost through Early Access for researchers using Xenium or Atera and is expected to launch commercially in early 2027 as a paid analysis platform with consumption-based credit pricing and planned enterprise subscription options. The company says GPU acceleration can reduce the analysis iteration cycle from hours on CPU alternatives to minutes.
quarterly_data.figure: Early Access at no cost; commercial launch expected early 2027

quarterly_data.quarter: 10x Genomics press release: 10x Genomics Announces Sentira, a New Computational (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 10x Genomics is collaborating with NVIDIA: NVIDIA accelerated computing runs the spatial workflow from real-time data processing on the Atera instrument to downstream analysis in Sentira Spatial, and rapids-singlecell, co-developed by scverse and NVIDIA, is integrated directly into Sentira Spatial.
